							<script type="text/javascript">
						function ama(){
					var userID = document.forms["loginForm"]["userid-content"].value;
					var pwd = document.forms["loginForm"]["password-content"].value;
						if(userID == "" || userID == null || userID.length < 5){
							$( "#userFail" ).fadeIn( 300 ).delay( 1500 ).fadeOut( 400 );
							document.getElementById("userid-content").style.borderColor = "red";
							return false;
						}else if(pwd == "" || pwd == null || pwd.length < 5){
							$( "#pwdFail" ).fadeIn( 300 ).delay( 1500 ).fadeOut( 400 );
							document.getElementById("password-content").style.borderColor = "red";
							return false;
						}	
					}
						
							</script>
